verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents the server role: an official Sentry MCP server that lets outside AI assistants connect to Sentry. Nothing shows Sentry or Seer acting as an MCP client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to use their tools, and the server-side evidence does not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
